info.name: Getting Blue Noise from White
info.description: high passing white noise to get blue noise. one important detail is that you should map the original input from [0, 1] to [-1, +1] by performing [code](x * 2. - 1.)[/code] and undo it at the very end by doing [code](x * .5 + .5)[/code]
